metadata.title: Dostarlimab, Paclitaxel and Carboplatin Therapy
metadata.indication: dMMR/MSI-H primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer requiring systemic therapy.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Encoded protocol · full source coverage review pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: The protocol has executable SACTCheck content but has not yet completed the v0.68.0 full source fidelity review. Use the current NCCP source as authoritative.

contexts.source_schedule_interval_label: Combination every 21 days; first maintenance dose 3 weeks after cycle 6, then every 42 days
contexts.duration_text: Six combination cycles followed by dostarlimab maintenance for up to 3 years, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00929 Version 1. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: dMMR/MSI-H primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer requiring systemic therapy.

treatment.schedule_summary: Combination every 21 days for six cycles. Give the first dostarlimab-only dose three weeks after cycle 6, then every 42 days, subject to the NCCP stopping criteria.

alt_ast_uln_multiple.label: ALT / AST actual result (highest ×ULN calculated automatically)

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.label: Other clinically relevant non-haematological toxicity grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

non_haematological_toxicity_grade.assessment_guidance: Identify the named toxicity and grade it using the applicable CTCAE term rather than a generic impression.

hypersensitivity_grade.label: Infusion or hypersensitivity reaction grade

options.label: Grade 1
options.description: Mild transient reaction; interruption not indicated.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Prolonged or recurrent reaction; hospitalisation indicated.

hypersensitivity_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess timing, treatment required, recurrence and airway or haemodynamic compromise.

gfr_or_crcl_ml_min.label: Measured GFR or protocol-approved CrCl for carboplatin calculation

renal_input.reason: Exact GFR/CrCl is required for Calvert carboplatin dosing.

paclitaxel_neuropathy_grade.label: Paclitaxel peripheral neuropathy grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate symptoms limiting instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe symptoms limiting self-care activities of daily living.

paclitaxel_neuropathy_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess sensory/motor symptoms, gait, fine motor function and effect on daily activities.

pneumonitis_grade.label: Clinician-assessed immune-mediated pneumonitis grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

pneumonitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess respiratory symptoms, oxygen requirement, imaging and exclude infection.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.label: Clinician-assessed immune-mediated colitis grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools/day; limits instrumental activities.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Increase of ≥7 stools/day, incontinence or hospitalisation; limits self-care.

diarrhoea_colitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess stool frequency above baseline, blood, pain, hydration and systemic features.

rash_grade.label: Immune-mediated rash/dermatitis grade

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate rash or symptoms limiting instrumental activities.

rash_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess morphology, body-surface area, mucosal involvement and function.

creatinine_ratio_baseline_or_uln.label: Creatinine ratio versus baseline or ULN

cortisol_nmol_l.label: Cortisol (optional; interpret by sample time/steroid exposure)

starting_first_cycle.label: Assessing eligibility before the first dose

eligibility_concern.label: First-dose eligibility or caution (assess each applicable issue)

options.label: Active clinically significant infection requiring therapy
Autoimmune disease, immunosuppression, previous ILD or function-limiting neuropathy
Liver metastases with grade 2 AST/ALT at baseline

immune_event_grade.label: Clinician-assigned CTCAE v5 grade of the selected event

options.label: Grade 2
options.description: Moderate; intervention may be indicated and instrumental activities may be limited.

options.label: Grade 3
options.description: Severe or medically significant; hospital care may be indicated and self-care may be limited.

immune_event_grade.assessment_guidance: NCCP 00929 Table 3 cites CTCAE v5.0. Select the event-specific CTCAE term and its applicable grade. General severity labels alone do not establish the diagnosis or grade. Grade 0 records absence of the event.

severe_skin_status.label: Exfoliative skin reaction (SJS, TEN or DRESS)

immune_recurrence.label: Recurrent grade 3/4 immune toxicity after resolution to grade 0/1 (exclude pneumonitis and infusion reactions)

endocrine_refractory.label: Adrenal insufficiency or hypophysitis recurring/worsening on adequate hormonal therapy

infusion_recurrent.label: Recurrent grade 2 dostarlimab infusion reaction despite adequate premedication

liver_exception_confirmed.label: Liver metastases and baseline grade 2 AST/ALT: rise of at least 50% from baseline sustained for at least one week

output_templates.proceed: No encoded restriction was triggered in the entered domain(s). This is not an overall treatment clearance.
output_templates.coverage_gap: Only entered values were assessed; omitted clinically relevant domains remain unassessed.
output_templates.consultant_review: The entered value requires protocol-specific Consultant/pharmacy review.
output_templates.withhold: Withhold treatment and reassess according to the official NCCP pathway.
output_templates.dose_reduce: Apply the encoded dose-reduction pathway and confirm against the official source.
output_templates.contraindicated: The entered value triggers an encoded contraindication/exclusion.
output_templates.permanently_discontinue: The entered value triggers permanent discontinuation in the encoded pathway.

action.message: ECOG 3–4 requires Consultant review of indication, benefit and treatment tolerance.

rules.explanation: ECOG 3–4 requires Consultant review of indication, benefit and treatment tolerance.

action.message: Grade 3 or worse non-haematological toxicity requires treatment interruption and protocol-specific review.

rules.explanation: Grade 3 or worse non-haematological toxicity requires treatment interruption and protocol-specific review.

action.message: Stop the infusion and initiate emergency management. Identify the causative infusion before deciding which drug to discontinue. Follow the agent-specific protocol.

rules.explanation: Stop the infusion and initiate emergency management. Identify the causative infusion before deciding which drug to discontinue. Follow the agent-specific protocol.

action.message: Delay paclitaxel and carboplatin until neutrophil recovery.

rules.explanation: Delay paclitaxel and carboplatin until neutrophil recovery.

action.message: Delay paclitaxel and carboplatin until platelet recovery. Confirm the individual threshold with the treating team.

rules.explanation: Delay paclitaxel and carboplatin until platelet recovery. Confirm the individual threshold with the treating team.

action.message: Arrange acute management of febrile neutropenia. Delay chemotherapy until recovery and discuss a 25% reduction of both chemotherapy drugs for subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: Arrange acute management of febrile neutropenia. Delay chemotherapy until recovery and discuss a 25% reduction of both chemotherapy drugs for subsequent cycles.

action.message: Extreme caution with carboplatin at GFR above 20 and up to 30 mL/min. Confirm kidney function measure and dosing with oncology pharmacy.

rules.explanation: Extreme caution with carboplatin at GFR above 20 and up to 30 mL/min. Confirm kidney function measure and dosing with oncology pharmacy.

action.message: Prior carboplatin hypersensitivity requires Consultant, pharmacy and allergy/desensitisation review.

rules.explanation: Prior carboplatin hypersensitivity requires Consultant, pharmacy and allergy/desensitisation review.

action.message: Discuss reducing paclitaxel by 25% for grade 2 neuropathy, or by 50% if grade 2 persists.

rules.explanation: Discuss reducing paclitaxel by 25% for grade 2 neuropathy, or by 50% if grade 2 persists.

action.message: Omit paclitaxel for grade 3 or 4 peripheral neuropathy.

rules.explanation: Omit paclitaxel for grade 3 or 4 peripheral neuropathy.

action.message: Elevated bilirubin requires the paclitaxel hepatic dose-modification table.

rules.explanation: Elevated bilirubin requires the paclitaxel hepatic dose-modification table.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab for grade 2 immune pneumonitis. Review for restart after recovery to grade 0 or 1. Recurrent grade 2 requires permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab for grade 2 immune pneumonitis. Review for restart after recovery to grade 0 or 1. Recurrent grade 2 requires permanent discontinuation.

action.message: Grade 3–4 immune pneumonitis requires permanent discontinuation.

rules.explanation: Grade 3–4 immune pneumonitis requires permanent discontinuation.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab for immune colitis grade 2 or 3. Reassess for restart after recovery to grade 0 or 1, including any previous severe episode.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab for immune colitis grade 2 or 3. Reassess for restart after recovery to grade 0 or 1, including any previous severe episode.

action.message: ALT/AST >3 ×ULN requires immune-hepatitis assessment and withholding.

rules.explanation: ALT/AST >3 ×ULN requires immune-hepatitis assessment and withholding.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab and urgently assess possible immune hepatitis. Confirm attribution, baseline liver involvement and the Table 3 exception before a permanent discontinuation decision.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab and urgently assess possible immune hepatitis. Confirm attribution, baseline liver involvement and the Table 3 exception before a permanent discontinuation decision.

action.message: Bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN requires immune-hepatitis assessment.

rules.explanation: Bilirubin >1.5 ×ULN requires immune-hepatitis assessment.

action.message: Creatinine >1.5 × baseline/ULN requires immune-nephritis assessment.

rules.explanation: Creatinine >1.5 × baseline/ULN requires immune-nephritis assessment.

action.message: Delay both chemotherapy drugs until recovery. Discuss reducing both by 25% for subsequent cycles.

rules.explanation: Delay both chemotherapy drugs until recovery. Discuss reducing both by 25% for subsequent cycles.

action.message: Below the first-dose neutrophil eligibility threshold. Defer initiation and review with the treating team.

rules.explanation: Below the first-dose neutrophil eligibility threshold. Defer initiation and review with the treating team.

action.message: Do not administer carboplatin at GFR of 20 mL/min or less.

rules.explanation: Do not administer carboplatin at GFR of 20 mL/min or less.

action.message: Paclitaxel is contraindicated at this hepatic threshold. Assess the other agents separately.

rules.explanation: Paclitaxel is contraindicated at this hepatic threshold. Assess the other agents separately.

action.message: Discontinue dostarlimab permanently for recurrent grade 2 immune pneumonitis.

rules.explanation: Discontinue dostarlimab permanently for recurrent grade 2 immune pneumonitis.

action.message: Discontinue dostarlimab permanently for grade 4 immune colitis.

rules.explanation: Discontinue dostarlimab permanently for grade 4 immune colitis.

action.message: Confirm the treatment phase and review this abnormal result before treatment. Chemotherapy thresholds apply only while paclitaxel and carboplatin are being given.

rules.explanation: Confirm the treatment phase and review this abnormal result before treatment. Chemotherapy thresholds apply only while paclitaxel and carboplatin are being given.

action.message: ECOG 2 requires individual consultant eligibility review. Higher count thresholds may be appropriate.

rules.explanation: ECOG 2 requires individual consultant eligibility review. Higher count thresholds may be appropriate.

action.message: Cap the GFR used for the Calvert calculation at 125 mL/min. Confirm the method and current renal function.

rules.explanation: Cap the GFR used for the Calvert calculation at 125 mL/min. Confirm the method and current renal function.

action.message: Defer initiation. Review the source exclusion and implicated agent. Any exceptional carboplatin rechallenge requires specialist review and a supervised desensitisation plan.

rules.explanation: Defer initiation. Review the source exclusion and implicated agent. Any exceptional carboplatin rechallenge requires specialist review and a supervised desensitisation plan.

action.message: Confirm eligibility, tumour test and individual caution before starting. Review treated/stable brain metastases and immunosuppression with the consultant.

rules.explanation: Confirm eligibility, tumour test and individual caution before starting. Review treated/stable brain metastases and immunosuppression with the consultant.

action.message: Use 75% of the original paclitaxel dose after confirmation of both ULN ratios and consultant review.

rules.explanation: Use 75% of the original paclitaxel dose after confirmation of both ULN ratios and consultant review.

action.message: Use 50% of the original paclitaxel dose after confirmation of both ULN ratios and consultant review.

rules.explanation: Use 50% of the original paclitaxel dose after confirmation of both ULN ratios and consultant review.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab. Consider restart only after immune nephritis improves to grade 0 or 1.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab. Consider restart only after immune nephritis improves to grade 0 or 1.

action.message: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for grade 3 or 4 immune nephritis.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for grade 3 or 4 immune nephritis.

action.message: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for confirmed severe immune hepatitis meeting the usual-baseline criteria.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for confirmed severe immune hepatitis meeting the usual-baseline criteria.

action.message: Discontinue dostarlimab after confirmation of the sustained increase from baseline specified for liver metastases.

rules.explanation: Discontinue dostarlimab after confirmation of the sustained increase from baseline specified for liver metastases.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab pending appropriate treatment and clinical and metabolic stability.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab pending appropriate treatment and clinical and metabolic stability.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab. Treat endocrine toxicity and review after recovery to grade 0 or 1.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab. Treat endocrine toxicity and review after recovery to grade 0 or 1.

action.message: Discontinue dostarlimab permanently for recurrent or worsening disease on adequate hormonal treatment.

rules.explanation: Discontinue dostarlimab permanently for recurrent or worsening disease on adequate hormonal treatment.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab for severe thyroid toxicity and review after recovery to grade 0 or 1.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab for severe thyroid toxicity and review after recovery to grade 0 or 1.

action.message: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab and urgently manage the confirmed cardiac or severe neurological event.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab and urgently manage the confirmed cardiac or severe neurological event.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab at any grade. Obtain urgent specialist assessment. Restart requires exclusion of the severe reaction and recovery to grade 0 or 1.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab at any grade. Obtain urgent specialist assessment. Restart requires exclusion of the severe reaction and recovery to grade 0 or 1.

action.message: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for confirmed severe exfoliative skin toxicity.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for confirmed severe exfoliative skin toxicity.

action.message: Withhold dostarlimab and review after recovery to grade 0 or 1.

rules.explanation: Withhold dostarlimab and review after recovery to grade 0 or 1.

action.message: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for grade 4 immune toxicity in the other-reactions category.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for grade 4 immune toxicity in the other-reactions category.

action.message: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for recurrent severe immune toxicity after prior recovery.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for recurrent severe immune toxicity after prior recovery.

action.message: Stop dostarlimab and treat the reaction. Apply the Table 3 timing, reduced infusion rate and premedication conditions before clinician-directed restart.

rules.explanation: Stop dostarlimab and treat the reaction. Apply the Table 3 timing, reduced infusion rate and premedication conditions before clinician-directed restart.

action.message: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for severe infusion reaction or recurrent grade 2 despite adequate premedication.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue dostarlimab for severe infusion reaction or recurrent grade 2 despite adequate premedication.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: NCCP 00929 v1 p8: carboplatin high, paclitaxel low, dostarlimab minimal. Select the current phase.

treatment_phases.label: Cycle 7 onwards · dostarlimab alone
treatment_phases.frequency: First maintenance infusion three weeks after cycle six, then every six weeks. Maintenance monotherapy may continue for up to three years, until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
treatment_phases.schedule_interval_label: First dose 3 weeks after cycle 6, then every 42 days
treatment_phases.duration_text: Up to 3 years of dostarlimab maintenance, stopping earlier for progression or unacceptable toxicity.
